scope: Incremental acceptance audit; pending does not mean absent or broken. Earlier QA evidence must be linked and checked case by case. Unit success alone is not full integrated acceptance.

cases.scenario: Nueva partida con cada combinación de seis biomas y cinco culturas
cases.expected: Dos pasos, selección conservada y combinación válida; no se crea una sexta cultura.
cases.notes: All 30 combinations exercised in actual native selector: correct biome/culture, checked radio, enabled matching Start, exactly 5 cultures. Desert/Ethiopian choices retained after back and reopening. World entry observed for Sabana/Mapungubwe and Desert/Ethiopian. Remaining: actual world entry in other 28 combinations.

cases.scenario: Doble pulsación en Comenzar
cases.expected: Un mundo y una ranura; el inicio simulado del lab no se ejecuta detrás.
cases.notes: Coordinate double-click also aborted when iframe detached; second click delivery remains unproven. Result: one world, zero native-menu iframes; saved-slot list grew from one to two exactly, retaining prior 95-coin slot. Source cancels lab demonstration before timers. Remaining: both activation events actually delivered.

cases.scenario: Entrar al tutorial con 1.000 monedas y sin centro
cases.expected: Se permite colocar el primer centro por 800; no bloquea la condición de infraestructura.
cases.notes: Actual new tutorial: 1000 coins, no centre, enabled 800-coin centre; valid placement produced 200 coins and next tutorial reading. Directed domain test also passes. Initial center construction additionally verifies valid native-footprint routes, culture consistency and rejection without debit; funded flat-navigation fixtures do not replace prior UI or real-biome acceptance.

cases.scenario: Colocación de centro inválida o cancelada
cases.expected: No se cobra ni se suprimen props; se conserva la partida anterior.
cases.notes: Invalid overlap and Cancel leave 1000 unchanged. Domain test verifies no structure or suppression mutation. Cancelling the new-game selector preserved the existing Sabana/Mapungubwe slot at 95; subsequent separate Desert/Ethiopian start created exactly one additional slot and kept the first at 95. Initial center construction additionally verifies valid native-footprint routes, culture consistency and rejection without debit; funded flat-navigation fixtures do not replace prior UI or real-biome acceptance.

cases.scenario: Llegar al primer turno del día 1
cases.expected: Contratación en el momento del guion, no antes de colocar el centro.
cases.notes: Hire crew disabled before centre. After centre and first 5-coin millet planting the hiring reading appeared, hiring became available; one older man charged 100, balance 195 -> 95. Directed sequence/idempotency test passes.

cases.scenario: Pantallas pequeñas vertical/horizontal y texto largo
cases.expected: Precios, retratos, confirmación y texto no se cortan ni pisan la franja del Espíritu.
cases.notes: Hiring portraits, four profile prices, budget totals, rejected budget, enabled confirmation and expanded help verified at 390x844 and 844x390 in English and Spanish. Scrollable body retains footer; language switch preserves draft and wallet. English portrait pause label corrected. Placement/Spirit separation covered by prior screenshots.

cases.scenario: Abrir varias causas de pausa y cerrar solo una
cases.expected: La simulación continúa pausada mientras quede otra causa activa.
cases.notes: Stacked-pause domain and tutorial tests pass. Remaining: integrated browser visibility plus menu/settings overlapping pauses.

cases.scenario: Mostrar un error de fondos o selección inválida
cases.expected: Feedback legible, sin restaurar toasts invasivos o ejecutar el comando rechazado.
cases.notes: Overlap, blocked prop, crop obstruction and insufficient-funds errors observed in native placement banner. Free-ground centre purchase rejected at 95 without debit. Hiring draft of 200 at 195 disables confirmation with inline readable warning; valid 100-cost confirmation leaves 95.

cases.scenario: Avanzar 300 s diurnos a ×1
cases.expected: Transcurre el periodo 07:05–19:05 y solo esos 300 s alimentan crecimiento.
cases.notes: Game.advanceReal with continuously attended banana asserts exactly 300 progress at first dawn, no night progress, then 270 more daylight to maturity. Clock test covers 07:05 -> 19:05 after 300 real seconds.

cases.scenario: Noche tranquila completa
cases.expected: Se acelera a ×5 sin consumir agua ni crecimiento; reloj interno correcto.
cases.notes: Actual Game.advanceReal: calm 300-second night takes 60 real seconds, opens one dawn hiring pause. Banana growth and pending watering wait unchanged through the full night; internal elapsed and clock asserted.

cases.scenario: Aparecer incursión durante ×5
cases.expected: Cambio a ×1 antes de procesar movimiento y contactos del ataque.
cases.notes: Regression reproduced: one 20ms frame at 399.95 gave 400.05 and 100ms of movement on attack spawn. Fixed: boundary at 400 before movement, remaining 10ms at x1, time 400.01. One frame matches two split frames, including positions and events.

cases.scenario: Retirarse primer animal mientras otros siguen presentes
cases.expected: No termina la incursión ni vuelve ×5 todavía.
cases.notes: Two-animal raid: first gone leaves raid active, no RaidEnded, next 20ms remains x1.

cases.scenario: Retirarse último animal durante la noche
cases.expected: Fin único del evento y ×5 si no queda otra pausa.
cases.notes: Last animal reaches its exit, one RaidEnded, following 20ms advances night by 100ms. No extra end event.

cases.scenario: Ocultar pestaña y volver tras muchos minutos
cases.expected: No hay ganancias, daño, riego ni avance offline.
cases.notes: 1800-second blocked real-time advances leave entire game state identical with menu plus hidden, and after only hidden clears. Remaining: actual browser hidden/restored timing and clock reset without offline advancement.

cases.scenario: Gran paso de tiempo cruza contratación o checkpoint
cases.expected: La simulación se divide y no omite el evento ni cobra dos jornadas.
cases.notes: Single 180-second simulation call reaches banana checkpoint, waits exactly 23.75 and freezes without losing debt. Separate 1000-second real calls stop at successive hiring pauses; only explicit daily confirmation charges 100 once, replay returns false, no automatic next-day debit.

cases.scenario: Ataque nocturno cruza amanecer
cases.expected: Aplicar el contrato C07 cuando se cierre; no perder ataque, contratación ni control de terminales.
cases.notes: Full-suite Game integration cases assert active raid holds clock at dawn, night completion/hiring wait for last departure, then close once; final-raid defeat precedes hundredth-night victory. Source closeNight applies event and economic check before victory/hiring.

cases.scenario: Plantar las ocho especies
cases.expected: Precio canónico, ID estable y brote; no aparecen arroz, calabaza ni judías del HUD.
cases.notes: Eight real Game.plant commands deduct exactly 309, preserve canonical IDs, create living zero-progress plants with initial tasks, and reject rice/pumpkin/beans without mutation. Original library gallery shows all eight sprouts. Remaining: verify all eight immediate sprouts in production game rendering.

cases.scenario: Mijo y plátano continuamente atendidos con día/noche
cases.expected: Tiempos efectivos 140 y 570 s; la noche no los acorta.
cases.notes: Ideal manual attendance through the real game clock gives millet 140 daylight/real seconds and banana 570 daylight/630 real seconds across one 60-real-second night. Banana elapsed simulated time 870, next-day time 270.

cases.scenario: Crear riegos inicial y posteriores
cases.expected: Exactamente R checkpoints lógicos, inicial incluido, sin cobrar agua adicional ni duplicar tarea.
cases.notes: An actual olderFemale worker cares for each of eight species through repeated real day/night cycles. Exact WaterSatisfied counts 2/3/2/3/2/4/2/6, all manual, no duplicate pending initial/water tasks, no growth before initial completion, final wallet equals seed plus explicit wages only.

cases.scenario: Checkpoint del plátano con margen de tolerancia
cases.expected: Margen derivado 23,75 s de tiempo diurno; no usar un porcentaje fijo de todo el ciclo.
cases.notes: Banana checkpoint at 95, freezes at growth 118.75 with exactly 23.75 overdue daylight seconds; no full-cycle percentage substituted.

cases.scenario: Agotar tolerancia por falta de agua
cases.expected: Se detiene crecimiento, no muere la planta; un riego posterior reanuda.
cases.notes: Large step and further 50 seconds leave dry banana alive and growth fixed; manual water restores 10 seconds of growth without a debit.

cases.scenario: Llegar la noche con deuda de agua y 10 s de margen restante
cases.expected: Margen permanece igual hasta el día siguiente.
cases.notes: Banana due-water wait 13.75 leaves ten seconds; full accelerated night leaves growth and wait unchanged; ten more daylight seconds exhaust tolerance and freeze.

cases.scenario: Llegar al 100% y dejar varias jornadas
cases.expected: Madura estable sin agua ni deterioro, hasta orden de cosecha o ataque.
cases.notes: Actually matured millet stays byte-identical over four dawns without water, decay, harvest orders or crates. Weather/raids deliberately absent in fixture.

cases.scenario: Primer cuidado y deuda que cruza madurez con tolerancia larga
cases.expected: Cubrir C04 explícitamente; no añadir riegos ni eliminar deuda por intuición.
cases.notes: Paid sprout does not grow before initial care, including Growth. Cassava crosses two real nights, holds just below 480 with final water due and wait below 288; final watering allows maturity without adding or deleting checkpoints.

cases.scenario: Seleccionar un grupo con plantas maduras e inmaduras
cases.expected: Solo maduras generan tareas; plantas se recogen una a una.
cases.notes: Connected four-plant group contains two mature/two immature. Two harvest commands select only mature plants; workers pick individually, immature plants remain alive and unrequested.

cases.scenario: Dos órdenes de cosecha del mismo grupo
cases.expected: Una tarea reservable por planta, sin dos cajas ni doble ingreso.
cases.notes: Different command IDs requesting same group still create two distinct tasks/crates, two pickup events and exactly two settlements (+22 total male millet), with no repeated income.

cases.scenario: Orden de grupo emitida al mismo instante
cases.expected: Se inserta de cerca a lejos del centro y después respeta FIFO.
cases.notes: Harvest request from farthest member inserts near-to-far within centre after an already queued watering task; task-created order strictly increases.

cases.scenario: Recogida individual con dos trabajadores
cases.expected: Plantas y reservas distintas, posible ejecución paralela sin compartir objetivo.
cases.notes: Real two-worker harvest loop observes two reserved tasks concurrently, different worker IDs and target IDs, then both physical crate deliveries.

cases.scenario: Aplicar Crecimiento sobre cultivo con riego previo pendiente
cases.expected: No cura la carencia ni avanza crecimiento hasta atención manual.
cases.notes: Initial unwatered sprout remains zero under Growth, retaining its initial task. Dry maize with pre-existing water debt stays frozen during effect until manually watered. Real-worker sunflower variant also stays frozen until care.

cases.scenario: Cruzar uno o varios checkpoints dentro de Crecimiento
cases.expected: Cada checkpoint cruzado queda satisfecho una vez; no aparece tarea atrasada al terminar.
cases.notes: Actual 30-second casts across all eight canonical species satisfy the crossed threshold, leave later thresholds future and create no deferred water tasks. Canonical 45 maximum progress cannot cross two thresholds whose smallest interval is 60; existing crop kernel tests cover multiple thresholds separately.

cases.scenario: Riego manual llega mientras Crecimiento sigue activo
cases.expected: Reanuda con ×1,5 y satisface automáticamente los siguientes checkpoints cruzados durante el efecto.
cases.notes: A real worker reaches dry sunflower during active Growth, manual watering resumes exactly 24 progress in 16 seconds and next checkpoint becomes magic; exactly one manual WaterSatisfied event.

cases.scenario: Terminar Crecimiento justo al cruzar un checkpoint
cases.expected: Orden temporal determinista; no regar dos veces por un mismo umbral.
cases.notes: Maize reaches checkpoint 90 at exact 30-second effect expiry: one magic status, later checkpoint future, no water task after expiry or queue rebuilding.

cases.scenario: Cosecha con Multiplicar solicitado antes pero recogido después de caducar
cases.expected: No recibe ×2; manda el instante de recogida.
cases.notes: Multiply active when requesting harvest expires before actual olderMale pickup: crate value 10.8, physical delivery pays 11, single pickup.

cases.scenario: Cosecha dentro del área activa por hombre
cases.expected: Aplicar +20% del recolector y ×2 según C02, fijando el valor una sola vez.
cases.notes: Multiply cast during actual male harvest action produces one 21.6-valued crate. Save/reload and subsequent expiry preserve value; delivery rounds once to 22, further time creates no second settlement.

cases.scenario: Cargar guardado de una planta en pleno morph
cases.expected: Misma fase/progreso y malla correcta; no reiniciar el crecimiento.
cases.notes: Not audited against this full acceptance case yet.

cases.scenario: Comparar estados originales y transición de cada especie
cases.expected: Cuarenta modelos, puentes locales opacos y UV correctas; sin dithering de cultivos.
cases.notes: Actual menu Library -> Crops lab loads without console errors. Five reference stages viewed for all eight crops and screenshots inspected. Remaining: compare production morph bridges and UVs against these 40 originals and verify opacity/no dithering in rendering.

cases.scenario: Confirmar plantilla mayor/joven del mismo sexo o sexo distinto
cases.expected: 100/120 de salario por edad, no por sexo, pago único por jornada.
cases.notes: Actual hiring of two employees for each profile charges 100/120 by age, preserves sex-independent wage and contract day, and repeated confirmation leaves serialized state unchanged.

cases.scenario: Editar cantidades o recordar selección impagable
cases.expected: No se descuenta; confirmar se bloquea hasta que el coste sea asumible.
cases.notes: Actual native HUD at day 2: naturally generated Sabana/Mapungubwe/712 game begins with 1000, delivers five millet crates, ends with 110 and remembered youngMale=1 costing 120. Confirm disabled. Editing to olderMale=1 keeps wallet 110, enables cost 100, and confirmation leaves 10. Independent QA origin 5176; user origin 5173 preserved.

cases.scenario: Confirmar cero trabajadores con partida recuperable
cases.expected: Jornada continúa sin plantilla; no reembolso ni producción ficticia.
cases.notes: Confirming zero workers advances 120 simulated seconds on a funded recoverable farm without watering, growth, crates, income or defeat.

cases.scenario: 6 contratados y centros con 100/20/0 plantas
cases.expected: Reparto 4/1/1 con desempate por antigüedad; el centro vacío conserva su base.
cases.notes: Actual Game planting and hiring: 100/20/0 live crops, six workers, exact quotas 4/1/1 including the empty center.

cases.scenario: Menos trabajadores que centros y números de plantas distintos
cases.expected: Uno a cada centro mayor hasta agotarlos; nunca dos en uno antes de ese reparto.
cases.notes: Actual hiring: 1/100/20 crops, two workers, exact quotas 0/1/1; no second worker before covering higher weights.

cases.scenario: Empate de plantas con personal escaso
cases.expected: Desempate determinista por antigüedad/ID.
cases.notes: Equal living plant counts tested with both oldest creation order and equal timestamps resolved by persistent ID; reversing structure array does not change allocation.

cases.scenario: Todos los centros tienen cero plantas
cases.expected: Personal repartido equilibradamente; queda esperando tareas reales.
cases.notes: Eight employees at three empty centers produce 3/3/2; advancing time generates no tasks, plants or crates.

cases.scenario: Mismo número de plantas con especies, precios y riegos diferentes
cases.expected: Mismo peso de reparto; no optimiza carga ni bonus ocultamente.
cases.notes: Six plants each of millet/cotton/banana with differing biological state give equal 2/2/2 quotas; species price and watering needs do not alter plant weights.

cases.scenario: Poblados con tamaños muy distintos
cases.expected: Reparto directo por centros del mundo, no 50/50 por poblado.
cases.notes: Synthetic large and small village populations in Game state produce global plant quotas 4/1/1; no village-first allocation. This test does not render population meshes.

cases.scenario: Cuatro perfiles con cupos desiguales
cases.expected: Mezcla equilibrada dentro de lo posible; no asignación por bonus de cosecha.
cases.notes: Actual 9/2/1 quotas with three of each profile now yield 2/2/2/3 in largest center, two different profiles in two-slot center, conserved totals and save roundtrip. Previous round robin produced 1/2/3/3; production fix 12c521a.

cases.scenario: Dos trabajadores libres y una tarea antigua
cases.expected: FIFO escoge tarea; la ejecuta el libre de ese centro más cercano.
cases.notes: Not audited against this full acceptance case yet.

cases.scenario: Dos agentes evalúan la misma planta/caja
cases.expected: Reserva atómica al aceptar; solo un propietario.
cases.notes: Not audited against this full acceptance case yet.

cases.scenario: Crear muchas tareas nuevas en centro con plantilla fija
cases.expected: No mueve trabajadores de otro centro durante la jornada.
cases.notes: Adding twelve crops at a new midday center and advancing 30 seconds preserves all existing employee assignments and origins; no cross-center transfer.

cases.scenario: Nuevo centro al mediodía junto a cultivos existentes
cases.expected: No migra plantas ni tareas; reasociación al siguiente amanecer.
cases.notes: Actual midday construction preserves old crop and staff bindings; advancing through day and night reassigns all thirteen crops and their tasks to nearer center at dawn. Four new workers allocate 1/3 and cost 400 once.

cases.scenario: Nueva planta junto a centro recién construido
cases.expected: Se vincula al centro más cercano ahora; espera si ese centro no tiene plantilla.
cases.notes: Twelve new crops bind to nearest current center with no employees, retain unreserved initial tasks and zero growth after 30 seconds; existing employees do not transfer.

cases.scenario: Nuevo poblado cambia centro de residencia territorial
cases.expected: Trabajador de hoy conserva residencia de salida y vuelve allí.
cases.notes: Actual founding changes center territorial association while existing worker retains culture, contract and origin, physically returns home and survives save/reload identically. Following-day hire starts at new village entry. Full route cost tested for direct path, detour and inaccessible endpoints; navigation fixtures do not prove real terrain connectivity.

cases.scenario: Destruir centro y quedar otro operativo del mismo poblado
cases.expected: Tras ataque se reasignan trabajadores desplazados según necesidad definida, sin cobrar otra jornada.
cases.notes: Not audited against this full acceptance case yet.

cases.scenario: Destruir último centro del poblado y no quedar destino
cases.expected: Regresan; no teletransportar a un poblado ajeno ni prolongar turno.
cases.notes: Not audited against this full acceptance case yet.

cases.scenario: Construir sustituto y haber desplazados aún disponibles
cases.expected: Aplicar excepción de destrucción, sin reasignar empleados normales de otros centros.
cases.notes: Not audited against this full acceptance case yet.

cases.scenario: Rehacer cola al amanecer o regreso de ataque
cases.expected: Usar necesidades reales; no regenerar reparaciones manuales.
cases.notes: Actual scripted campaign raid start/end releases reservations and cancels manual repair; exhausted animal budget drives real exit/rebuild. Only current initial care, watering debt and expressly ordered harvest regenerate. Repeated rebuilds and reload do not duplicate tasks. Real dawn also removes manual repair. This isolates queue behavior, not natural raid probability or damage.

cases.scenario: Rehacer cola con cosecha ya ordenada
cases.expected: Aplicar C05 expresamente; madurez sola nunca se convierte en orden automática.
cases.notes: Two physically attended mature crops: only the explicitly ordered one regenerates a harvest task after real dawn or scripted raid exit. Logical order survives repeated queue rebuilds and save/reload; unordered mature crop generates no harvest.

cases.scenario: Finalizar turno camino de tarea aún no ejecutada
cases.expected: Se libera reserva y no comienza tarea nueva fuera del turno.
cases.notes: All four profiles physically walk to a distant unstarted task at shift boundary 250/300, atomically release reservation, start returning and leave crop unwatered with zero growth. No positional/time teleport used; clear-path funded integration fixture.

cases.scenario: Finalizar turno durante ejecución física
cases.expected: Completa esa tarea según la regla de jornada y se retira.
cases.notes: All four profiles physically begin initial care shortly before their shift boundary, finish that committed care after the boundary exactly once, then return without taking the second queued plant. Clear-path funded integration; visual native animation inspection is separate.

cases.scenario: Inactividad sin tarea
cases.expected: Alterna reposo/vigilar y paseos caminando a máximo aproximado 8 m.
cases.notes: Not audited against this full acceptance case yet.

cases.scenario: Aparecer tarea durante paseo
cases.expected: Cancela paseo y sale desde posición actual, sin teletransporte.
cases.notes: Not audited against this full acceptance case yet.

cases.scenario: Carrera de trabajo agotada
cases.expected: No sigue corriendo por urgencia ordinaria; restaura reserva al amanecer.
cases.notes: Three pending tasks cause real ordinary running until distance reserve is exhausted; subsequent motion is exactly walking and contracts unchanged. Returning worker retained at real dawn receives full reserve while old contract remains expired; fresh contract receives full reserve with distinct person while old one returns.

cases.scenario: Urgencia de cola bajo/por encima de 2 por trabajador
cases.expected: Solo afecta carrera ordinaria, nunca distribución de plantilla.
cases.notes: Equal living plant counts at two centers with 2 versus 3 tasks retain equal one-worker quotas and stable assignments. Worker with ratio 2 walks without reserve use; ratio 3 runs and consumes reserve. Unordered mature plant remains a weight without becoming a harvest task.

cases.scenario: Recoger una planta sin entregar la caja
cases.expected: No aumenta el dinero; valor fijado y planta retirada una vez.
cases.notes: Actual male millet pickup after physical care and ordered harvest removes source once and freezes a pending crate value 54/5, while wallet remains unchanged until physical delivery. Crate provenance and carrying state survive reload.

cases.scenario: Entregar una caja y repetir callback/carga
cases.expected: Un solo ingreso y caja entregada no recuperable otra vez.
cases.notes: Physical delivery after carrying save/reload pays ceil(54/5)=11 exactly once. Replaying exact settlement ID leaves serialized state unchanged. Loading delivered snapshot and rebuilding/advancing creates no crate or harvest recovery task, no second payment.

cases.scenario: Ataque sorprende portador
cases.expected: Caja cae en su posición y no es objetivo animal.
cases.notes: Actual warthog raid interrupts a physically carrying worker: drop at worker position, cleared carrier, no income; no animal targets or consumes the crate throughout attack and retreat. Funded campaign/clear navigation fixture, not rendered acceptance.

cases.scenario: Volver tras ataque con cajas sueltas
cases.expected: Tarea de transporte reservable individualmente cuando exista centro válido.
cases.notes: After real raid exit, one crate task survives rebuild/reload; next-day older female physically reserves, picks up and delivers the original crate once. Separate regression preserves existing transport reservation when building another center.

cases.scenario: Caja sin centro operativo
cases.expected: Persiste sin convertirse en ingresos ni tarea hasta infraestructura válida.
cases.notes: No operational center: crate retains value and position across reload/rebuild/wait without task or income. Replacement center now selectively enqueues transport, recovers displaced employee, and physical delivery pays 11 once. Explicit destruction/exhausted raid budget isolate recovery.

cases.scenario: Centro con cero plantas y cajas
cases.expected: Usa su trabajador base; no crea una planta ficticia para calcular el reparto.
cases.notes: Next real dawn hiring with no live plants retains the center base worker; she reserves and physically delivers loose crate. No fictitious plant added to staffing weights.

cases.scenario: Mostrar 150.000 y cantidades de millones
cases.expected: HUD abreviado sin desbordamiento; saldo real no pierde precisión.
cases.notes: Actual native menu/game HUD shows 150K and 1,23M for explicitly financed QA snapshots. Desktop and mobile CSS portrait/landscape text fits panel with no horizontal overflow. Normal save-and-return retains exactly 150000/1 and 1234567/1. Desktop viewport emulation, not physical mobile performance.

cases.scenario: Combinación de bonus produce una fracción monetaria
cases.expected: C02 decide redondeo una vez; no importar Math.round del lab silenciosamente.
cases.notes: Male yield, Multiply activated during physical harvest and explicit fertile event fix rational crate value 594/25. Power expires before another profile delivers; only settlement rounds upward to 24 once. Reload during transport/rebuild after delivery preserve value without double payment.

cases.scenario: Cerrar perímetro de cada material
cases.expected: Se genera la puerta determinista; misma compra y 60% de PV.
cases.notes: All five paid enclosure previews/commits use real Navigation on explicitly flat prop-free terrain, deterministic single automatic gate, canonical per-piece cost and 60% HP; command replay and snapshot preserve a single payment/layout. Native layout and original wall/gate geometry are covered in the same directed run. Browser purchasing/placement terrain matrix belongs to separate UI/placement acceptance.

cases.scenario: Golpear zarzas intactas dos veces a 40 PV
cases.expected: Al quedar 20 PV comienza el colapso; no exige un tercer golpe.
cases.notes: Two actual committed warthog combos completed through Game.tick leave brambles at 60 then 20 HP; the second starts collapse, 1.4 simulated seconds finish one persistent ruin, pause/reload cannot duplicate damage. Original WorldScene browser readbacks/visuals independently confirm two controlled 40-HP hits, falling BAST and final ruin.

cases.scenario: Golpear centro de 600 PV con cada especie
cases.expected: Colapso tras 12/10/7/6/4 golpes desde intacto sin reparación.
cases.notes: Committed attack clock and snapshot path verified for five species in all five cultures: 600-HP center collapses after 12/10/7/6/4 canonical hits with no repair. Individual animal budgets remain legal; additional controlled animals supply further hits. Explicit QA recovery funds prevent economic defeat from freezing the collapse-clock test. Selection/arrival/contact are outside this case and remain separate IA gates.

cases.scenario: Entrar al umbral de BAST o DEST
cases.expected: Respeta 20% de vida/79% de daño respectivamente, sin unificación silenciosa.
cases.notes: Inclusive distinct boundaries checked just above and exactly at 20% BAST remaining and 79% DEST damage; durations 1.4/3.2 seconds, no repeat hit during irreversible collapse. Production WorldScene browser verifies 126.01 center HP intact, 126 HP collapsing, visual fall and final ashes; bramble visual finishes at 1.4 seconds. No full renderer reload/streaming claim.

cases.scenario: Ordenar reparación con fondos suficientes
cases.expected: Se encola pero todavía no se cobra ni reserva dinero ficticio.
cases.notes: Native-footprint Navigation on declared flat clear terrain; first-day paid center/seed/wall/hire. Request and physical reservation retain wallet 60 without debit or reserved funds; repair applies at actual service-point arrival.

cases.scenario: Ordenar reparación con fondos insuficientes en ese instante
cases.expected: Se rechaza la solicitud, sin tarea inválida añadida.
cases.notes: Actual five wall purchases and another seed leave 5 coins. Requesting damaged wall repair costing 9.45 fails without any snapshot mutation, task, command or payment.

cases.scenario: Daño aumenta antes de llegada del reparador
cases.expected: Coste se recalcula al llegar, no se mantiene la cotización inicial.
cases.notes: During physical reserved repair journey, damage raises exact price from 9.45 to 15.40. Actual arrival charges ceil=16 once and restores original HP; no frozen quotation.

cases.scenario: Objetivo pasa a ruina antes de ejecutar orden todavía válida
cases.expected: No se cancela solo por destruirse; coste 100% y se reconstruye si alcanza.
cases.notes: Already-reserved manual wall repair survives explicit full destruction outside a raid, natural collapse to ruin and reload. Physical arrival reconstructs same target for full original 35. Flat terrain fixture; not a claim of an active raid preserving manual repair.

cases.scenario: Saldo disminuye por otras compras antes de reparar
cases.expected: Revalida saldo al llegar; si no alcanza, cancela sin cargo.
cases.notes: Other genuine purchases while worker walks leave 5 coins. Existing reservation survives until actual arrival, which cancels without debit or restoration and reports insufficient funds.

cases.scenario: Ataque interrumpe una reparación en camino
cases.expected: Huida y reconstrucción de cola; esa reparación manual no se regenera sola.
cases.notes: Actual warthog raid immediately releases walking repair, worker flees, full damage/retreat runs with native hit budget. After departure, rebuild and reload do not regenerate repair; no repair charge/event.

cases.scenario: Trabajador llega durante animación de colapso
cases.expected: Resolver C06 sin cancelar D144 ni confundir reset del lab con permiso de reparación.
cases.notes: C06 tested both ways: active raid cancels before arrival; outside a raid full destruction immediately before real arrival preserves still-valid order and reconstructs for full 35 during collapse. No delayed automatic repair or cancellation solely on target destruction.

cases.scenario: Reparación exitosa repetida por callback
